label: Claude with Spec Kit
install: set -e; curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash; curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; uv tool install specify-cli --from git+https://github.com/github/spec-kit.git
run: set -e; specify init --here --ai claude --force --ignore-agent-tools --no-git > /dev/null; c() { claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose --permission-mode bypassPermissions ${SWE_MODEL:+--model "$SWE_MODEL"} "$@"; }; { printf '/speckit.specify '; cat "$SWE_PROMPT"; } | c; for s in /speckit.plan /speckit.tasks /speckit.implement; do printf '%s Work without asking questions: no one will answer. Take the recommended choice at each point.\n' "$s" | c --continue; done
fired: any(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init" and ((.slash_commands // []) | any(tostring | test("speckit")))) and (map(select(.type == "result" and (.is_error | not))) | length) >= 4
